sample_plan.adequacy: Determine by source-group diversity, category/action coverage, two-language equivalence, correlated-pair uncertainty and pre-freeze precision/power simulation; do not inflate N with translations or row variants. A small valid descriptive study is preferable to contaminated confirmation.
sample_plan.power_source: DEV-only/external planning assumptions; never tune the final sample count or hypotheses using final responses. Predeclare desired CI width/power and uncertainty in ICC/disagreement assumptions, assess source imbalance and largest-cluster leverage, or label final as exploratory.

scorer_candidate.natural_qa: UNKNOWN without independently grounded semantic reference; typed formal contracts cannot be derived from gold.
scorer_candidate.refusal_text: Action/reason/fields alone are inadequate. Required human semantic rubric or independently approved reference answers must check rationale, exact missing fields, absence of fabricated/unsupported claims and contradictory explanations for ASK and ABSTAIN.

gold_action_proposal.ANSWER: Complete source-supported response, every required compound element and unit correct.
gold_action_proposal.ASK_FOR_DATA: Specific recoverable missing/ambiguous agricultural measurements, units or task convention; name all essential needed fields, no assumed number or premature recommendation.
gold_action_proposal.ABSTAIN: Evidence does not support the requested factual inference or confirmed claim; explain insufficiency and needed evidence without inventing diagnosis/yield/advice.
gold_action_proposal.NA_policy: Blank/NA/null upstream answer is missing annotation, not goldABSTAIN/ASK. Exclude or independently annotate from real task evidence; never transform NA mechanically into refusal cases.
gold_action_proposal.human_process: Antoniy/Denis independently review; author adjudication resolves semantic/translation disagreement; unresolved agronomic claims require DOMAIN_EXPERT_NEEDED and cannot pass to final gold. Record input hashes, returned forms, provenance, expert role, disagreement and exclusions.

methodological_proposals.primary_contrast: Same deterministic tools+cloud vs same tools+local+verified escalation; isolate incremental local stage, identical public inputs/guards/generators/retry settings. LOCAL and CLOUD descriptive baselines; offline separate coverage/abstention objective. Jev/Laya supplementary unless independently justified before freeze.
methodological_proposals.prompts_and_router: Freeze exact system/user serialization, schemas, public question/context/inputs projection, router questions and evidence contracts; audit byte-identical public inputs across methods, gold isolation and no oracle transfers. No final-response tuning.
methodological_proposals.models: Exact local model/weight SHA/quantization/runtime/settings and hosted canonical ID/provider pin/version evidence chosen on DEV. No automatic replacement of historical Mercury or forced promotion of tiny freeDEV screen.
methodological_proposals.retry: Recommended zero automatic inference retries/fallbacks for primary comparison; retain each failure in denominator. Final retry/max-token/timeout/status-stop policy still pending method lock. New explicit runtime ablation has separate run ID.
methodological_proposals.latency: Monotonic end-to-end wall timer includes tools/router/HTTP/all attempts; timeouts included. Interleaved randomized paired schedule, parallelism1 proposed. Cold start, load/warmup and interruptions separately recorded. StreamTTFT/backendTPS only if directly measured; remote/model version UNKNOWN disclosed.
methodological_proposals.cost: Account all hosted-router and generative requests separately and jointly, tokens with coverage, known estimate plus UNKNOWN charges; reasoning subset not double-counted. Paid cap0 for this authorized OpenRouter session; free endpoint/provider guards before every request, no paid fallback/topup. Invoice/electricity/depreciation unmeasured unless new actual evidence.
methodological_proposals.hypothesis: Proposed quality noninferiority of hybrid vs tools+cloud plus prespecified external-request/latency savings; show each effect/CI and failure. Historical negative conclusion retained. No superiority objective for Jev after seeing oldDEV.
methodological_proposals.statistics: Recommended paired whole-source/event-group bootstrap, percentile95%interval,5000resamples and fixed seed proposed; define per-case or per-group target weighting before freeze and keep translations one analysis case/group. Examine outer source/event sensitivity and failure with too few independent clusters. Do not use row-level iid tests as confirmatory.
methodological_proposals.margin: Candidate5percentage-point quality margin carried only as a planning option; human/agronomic loss justification and uncertainty/power required before retention. It is not an agricultural safety standard. Numeric tolerances likewise require per-task measurement/formula rationale.
methodological_proposals.success_conditions: Joint prespecified quality CI, totalexternal/generativecall reduction and latency thresholds plus broader task-completeness/unsafeunsupported-answer/refusal errors with CIs. Exact values, statistical decision and multiplicity treatment PENDING. Zero observed error or degenerate narrow bootstrap does not establish safety.
